description: Call this first, whenever you are about to pay for anything (an x402 request, an API, data, compute, a card or Stripe payment): declare what you are buying and why, before paying. Sealed in your company's book. Amounts are integers in the currency's minor unit (cents; 6 decimals for USDC).

payee_id.description: Optional: who is to be paid, as scheme:value, such as wallet:0x59dd… for an x402 or onchain payment, or domain:data.example. Give it whenever you know it: check_payment then refuses a payment to anyone else, and a mandate that lists its payees refuses a payee not on the list.

product.description: Optional: what is being bought, such as an API plan, a dataset or a SKU

purpose.description: Why you are paying, in one sentence. This is what an auditor reads.

name: record_intent
